en: Changed Windows/WSL managed settings so an admin policy that is present but invalid or unreadable (HKLM, `managed-settings.json`) keeps user-writable HKCU and WSL `/etc/claude-code` from applying
zh: 变更 Windows/WSL 托管设置：当管理员策略存在但无效或无法读取（HKLM、`managed-settings.json`）时，阻止用户可写的 HKCU 和 WSL `/etc/claude-code` 生效
